title: Urban Ink and Wash — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Main Street sketch
scenes.purpose: A pedestrian survey view of a street is committed in dark pen; local colour opens over the landmark tower (the idea) and dotted links connect it to the surrounding blocks (the system).
visuals: Stationary cool-grey paper plane with seeded grain
One-point perspective street: horizon, road edges, two building blocks each side
Landmark clock tower with lamp at the vanishing centre (recurring anchor)
Transparent red wash over the tower with a bare-paper light gap; warm wash on the lamp; pale blue sky wash
Dotted connection curves from the lamp to six building corners with ink nodes

beats.development: Horizon and road edges are drawn in confident pen strokes, setting the big street structure.
Building blocks, the landmark tower, facade details, kerb hatching and the lamp circle complete the line pass.
Once the tower reads, a transparent red pigment island bleeds open over it through an irregular mask, lamp rays flick out and the lamp warms; ink remains visible through the wash.
Pale sky wash settles while dotted links travel from the lamp to six building corners and ink nodes land; caption and place note fade in.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system.

beats.development: Settled frame: full drawing, washes and captions hold for reading.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system.

findings: Line pass precedes all colour, per the style's timing rule; the wash starts only after the tower outline is complete at 1.35 s.
All motion settles by 2.45 s, before the 2.7 s requirement.
justifiedHolds: 2.45–3.0 s reading hold for the two-line caption and place note.

notes: Motion Graphic style-197 (Urban Ink and Wash) as primary; no optional recipes supplied, so the base characteristic action is demonstrated.
Canvas 2D redraws every frame from GSAP timeline state; one paused timeline at window.__timelines.video, redraw on hf-seek.
